scope: Independent static oracle review against primary repository DrawCommand/Canvas/layout/image semantics. No engine, Canvas, candidate adapter/planner, compiler, image decoder or GPU execution; no oracle or repository edits.

static_checks.conclusion: Canvas blends unlayered channels with (src*a + dst*(255-a) + 127)/255 each pass. The 128-alpha samples derive independently as (116,42,68), then (158,31,54); alpha-zero image pixels preserve (32,64,96). Packed high byte is zero. Literal palette/rows/files/RGB and packed hashes agree.

Translucent rectangle scanning is followed by integer-origin clip.contains checks. The fractional clip admits only x=1,2,3 at y=1, matching WPPPW; opaque fast-path upper-edge differences are not conflated with this translucent case.
PushFixed restores caller clip and replaces both offsets with viewport offset; PopFixed restores prior clip and offsets. Nested direct case manually traces to WRCRRW/WBMRRW/WRRYKW/WWWWWW.

Reversed diagonal and zero-length line commands become min-coordinate rectangles with each extent max(abs(delta),width). The authored GGBBW/GGBBW/WWWWW/RRRRW grid follows this behavior without line antialiasing assumptions.

Radius-one 2x2 coverage truncates to 202 at all four samples, producing (53,53,255) over white. Empty-clip text returns before font/glyph work, opacity one adds no layer, and alpha-zero rounded input paints nothing. Visible suffixes and separate no-submission assertion correctly require complete-frame fallback.

257 commands and depth 33 exceed unchanged probe caps 256/32 while remaining below Canvas 200000/128. Balanced streams and tiny visible grids justify nonexhausted CPU expectations. These cases do not cover all proposed bridge key/storage/CPU-work limits; the contract explicitly leaves those to independent boundary controls.

Explicit body geometry, positioned rectangles, ancestor clip/fixed handling, transparent placeholder suppression on successful load, and RGB(236,238,242) missing-image placeholder agree with the relevant source paths. Empty alt/content avoid font-based pixels. The five actual worker streams and exact PNG decode are still unobserved assumptions requiring later IPC/capture checks.

Snapshot decoding can retain Arc aliases via raster indices. Direct alias identity is separately specified; deterministic first-reference assignment and no HashMap-order dependency remain checker requirements. No CPU alpha scan is part of the expected accepted-image policy.

whole_frame_contract: Unsupported text, nonzero radius and opacity scopes must refuse before any GPU submission even when hidden; fallback is a separate admission result, while driver/map/readback mismatches remain failures. No existing implementation outcome was used as a pixel oracle.
limits: This is static clearance of the authored semantic oracle, not acceptance of future adapter output or proof of its accounting.
Worker HTML display lists, decoded image bytes, diagnostic retention and complete scoped command order still need exact frozen-input execution checks.
Lifecycle/confinement review and adapter API admission proof remain assigned separately.
No native browser GPU rasterization, broad standards/security claim, performance comparison or changed limits are established.
preparation_only_read_command_issues: An initial shell glob src/paint* matched no path; corrected using rg --files. A later rg list included absent src/resource.rs; remaining requested source reads completed. Neither command ran an engine or changed data.
